item.title: About
item.description: Chaf Chen joined NVIDIA in 2024 as a GPU Graphics Architect to work on problems at the performance of next generation GPU and new graphics methodology. Before that, he receive a Master’s degree and Bachelor’s degree from University of Science and Technology of China. Here he will share some recent projects and interesting stuff in graphics and GPU technology. Education University of Science and Technology of China, 2017.09~2021.07 School of Information Science and Technology, Automation Bachelor’s Degree University of Science and Technology of China, 2021.
